kmcmultiple.help: Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations of multiple holes or electrons with site exclusion in periodic boundary conditions: drift velocity, mobility, diffusion tensor and site occupations
kmcmultiple.label: calc:kmcmultiple

runtime.help: Simulated time in seconds (if a number of at most 100 is given) or number of KMC events (if a number larger than 100 is given; events are hops and attempts into occupied sites)

outputtime.help: Interval between outputs into the trajectory and time files, in the unit of runtime (seconds or accepted hops). Set to 0 for no trajectory.

trajectoryfile.help: Name of the trajectory file (run 0): unwrapped carrier positions in nm

timefile.help: Optional file with mean energy per carrier, mobility and distance travelled versus time (run 0)

occfile.help: File to write occupation probabilities (summed over carriers, averaged over runs)

resultfile.help: Main results as 'key value unit' lines in SI units (empty: none)

exact.help: Also compute drift velocity, mobility and diffusion tensor of one carrier without sampling (master equation; sparse linear systems)

seed.help: Integer to initialise the random number generator

runs.help: Number of independent runs (in parallel with OpenMP); with more than one, the errors are standard errors over the runs

equilibration.help: Simulated time at the start of each run that is left out of velocity, diffusion and occupations

blocks.help: Minimum number of time blocks for the diffusion tensor (between blocks and 2 blocks are used); the blocks must be longer than the memory of the motion

injectionpattern.help: Name pattern that specifies on which sites carriers are placed at the start. Use the wildcard '*' to place them on any site.

injectionmethod.help: random: start sites are selected randomly

numberofcarriers.help: Number of electrons/holes in the simulation box

carriertype.help: Specifies the carrier type of the transport under consideration.

waitingtime.help: Waiting-time method: exponential (static rates) or thinning (time-dependent rates with upper bounds)

maxrealtime.help: Maximum wall-clock time of each run

ignoresegments.help: Segment types (wildcards, separated by commas or spaces) without hops to or from them
